abstract_sentences.text: Generating long-form, multi-speaker conversational audio like podcasts poses significant challenges for traditional Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems, particularly in scalability, speaker consistency, and natural turn-taking.

evidence.anchor: significant challenges for traditional Text-to-Speech systems

abstract_sentences.text: We present VibeVoice, a novel model designed to synthesize expressive, long-form speech with multiple speakers in a zero-shot manner.

evidence.anchor: synthesize expressive, long-form speech with multiple speakers

abstract_sentences.text: A core component of our approach is the continuous speech tokenizers operating at an ultra-low frame rate of 7.5.

evidence.anchor: continuous speech tokenizers operating at an ultra-low frame rate of 7.5

abstract_sentences.text: This tokenizer effectively preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency for processing long sequences.

evidence.anchor: preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency

abstract_sentences.text: To facilitate training on authentic conversational dynamics, we have developed an annotation pipeline that generates pseudo transcriptions and turn-taking labels for extensive podcast data.

evidence.anchor: annotation pipeline that generates pseudo transcriptions and turn-taking labels

abstract_sentences.text: Leveraging this data and our efficient tokenizer, VibeVoice employs the next-token diffusion framework.

evidence.anchor: employs the next-token diffusion framework

abstract_sentences.text: This enables VibeVoice to: (1) synthesize long-form speech (up to 90 minutes) with up to 4 speakers, surpassing the typical 1-2 speaker limits of many prior models; and (2) achieve a high degree of naturalness in turn-taking, pacing, and the rendition of subtle non-lexical cues (such as breaths and lip smacks), which are crucial for listener immersion and capturing the authentic vibe of expressive conversations.

evidence.anchor: up to 90 minutes with up to 4 speakers

abstract_sentences.text: Code and checkpoint are available at https://github.com/microsoft/VibeVoice.

evidence.anchor: Code and checkpoint are available

experimental_design.name: acoustic_tokenizer_architecture
experimental_design.description: Mirror-symmetric 7-stage encoder-decoder；1D depth-wise causal convolution；六层 downsampling，24 kHz→7.5 frames/s，约 340M parameters per encoder/decoder；DAC discriminator/loss。

evidence.anchor: Six downsampling layers achieve a cumulative 3200x downsampling rate

experimental_design.name: semantic_tokenizer_training
experimental_design.description: 复用 acoustic encoder 结构，以 ASR cross-entropy proxy task 训练；decoder 预训练后丢弃。

evidence.anchor: trained exclusively on an ASR proxy task using a cross-entropy loss function

experimental_design.name: vibevoice_models
experimental_design.description: Qwen2.5 1.5B 与 7B；4-layer Diffusion Head，1.5B 约 123M parameters；两个 tokenizer 冻结，只训练 LLM 与 Diffusion Head。

evidence.anchor: pre-trained acoustic and semantic tokenizers remained frozen
progressively increasing from 4,096 to 65,536 tokens over 110k training steps

experimental_design.name: training_data_and_compute
experimental_design.description: 约 80B internal pseudo-labeled podcast tokens；1.5B 训练约 170 小时、64 AMD Instinct MI300X、nnscaler。具体采样清单与 individual data 未提供。

evidence.anchor: approximately 80 billion tokens from an internal pseudo-labeled podcast audio collection

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 podcast TTS 的长程、多说话人交互问题转化为 7.5 Hz 连续 acoustic/semantic hybrid 表示上的 segment-wise next-token diffusion 生成，并用伪标注 podcast 管线提供 turn-taking 学习信号；实证闭合到 1–30 分钟、1–4 speakers，90 分钟仍是扩展主张。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 保留问题动机、Figure 1、tokenizer/LLM/diffusion 机制、(1)–(6) 六个编号公式、训练规模、评测摘要、Table 1–3、Figure 3、STOI 解释和总体能力包装。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 将 Coupled 机制消融、SEED/LibriSpeech、RTF、训练超参数、108 段数据分布、MOS rubric、第一阶段评测和 spectrogram 分析移入 Appendix A–J；这些材料补足分母与反例，但未提供 90 分钟实测。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 → (1)–(3) 生成链 → (4)–(6) diffusion/CFG 链 → Table 2 范围矩阵 → Figure 3 条件消融；图、公式和表各自承担不同决策层。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 90 分钟/state-of-the-art/naturalness 的 capability wording 超过 1–30 分钟、8 个两说话人样本、单值 metrics 和非对称 baseline protocol 的证据包；next-token diffusion 与 turn-taking 的机制也缺少长程误差和受控反事实。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 组合式生成能力应在正文按 speaker count × duration × streaming protocol × metric 拆成矩阵，每个数字主张都要有直接覆盖；感知主张同时给 metric 定义、聚合单位和能区分替代解释的反事实。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于多说话人语音、视频和长上下文生成系统；若数据无法覆盖某一 duration 或 speaker 轴，应显式标为 partially_closed。单一短 utterance 研究可缩小矩阵，但仍需说明 metric 与人类感知边界。

statistical_analysis.aggregation_units: MOS 按 annotator/sample 报均值±标准差；WER/CER、SIM-O、PESQ、STOI、UTMOS、RTF 按 model/configuration/dataset split 报单值；Appendix G 总分母为 108 segments。
statistical_analysis.uncertainty: Table 1/11 主观分数有 mean±SD；Table 2/3/6/7/8 主要为 point estimates；无 CI、bootstrap、Bayesian、回归、显著性或多重比较。
statistical_analysis.decision_quantities: WER/CER 越低越好，SIM-O/PESQ/STOI/UTMOS/MOS/RTF 按各表方向解释；没有 preregistered threshold。
statistical_analysis.protocol_caveats: MoonCast 长多说话人结果含 successful-case/retry 或 subset；Higgs Audio V2 使用并行 3-second chunks；VibeVoice 采用 strict streaming。
